name: chrome-ext-deetz
description: Deetz: a compact Web Application Specifications panel for Chrome. Detects the CMS, frameworks, plugins, hosting and more behind any page, with evidence.
author: Joey Driscoll (https://jodriscoll.com)

scripts.check: node --check src/background.js && node --check src/rules.js && node --check src/detect.js && node --check src/panel.js && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('manifest.json'))"
